content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Main Pop Updates's PostMain Pop Updates Verified account5d · Shared with PublicJustin Bieber sets new Coachella record as highest paid headliner in festival history.The desert is heating up with more than just the music! Sources have confirmed that Justin Bieber has officially secured a record-breaking $10 million payday for his headlining set at Coachella 2026. This historic deal, which Bieber reportedly negotiated directly without an agent, places him at the top of the all-time earnings list, surpassing legendary payouts from past headliners.While superstars like Beyoncé, Lady Gaga, The Weeknd, and Ariana Grande previously set the bar with reported earnings around the $8 million mark, Bieber’s eight-figure check establishes a new industry benchmark.
